events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal event in music history, began on August 15, 1969, attracting over 400,000 people to Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm for '3 Days of Peace & Music'. The Woodstock Festival began today in '69. What's your favourite legendary performance?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the death of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away on August 16, 1977, at the age of 42.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, we lost the one and only Elvis Presley. His music continues to shake, rattle, and roll generations. What's your top track from The King?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the passing of legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix, who died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Legend
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled Jimi Hendrix, who left us far too soon. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire. What's the Hendrix track that truly blows your mind?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album in the UK on September 26, 1969, and in the US on October 1, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles delivered their masterpiece, 'Abbey Road'. That zebra crossing photo is still instantly recognisable. What's your standout track from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today, born September 7, 1951.

angles.name: Pretenders Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! The Pretenders' voice and spirit remain as powerful as ever. What's your favourite song from Chrissie?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today, born September 21, 1972.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Happy 54th Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the swagger and the tunes. What's your favourite track featuring his iconic vocals?

events.title: iPod's 25th anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music with its ability to put '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: Music in your Pocket
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listened to music forever. Who remembers their first iPod? #iPod #TechNostalgia

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: It's James Bond Day, celebrating the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, which premiered in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen with Dr. No. What's your all-time favourite Bond theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today, born October 9, 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide. What's the Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today, born October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty, his genius is undeniable. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's the anniversary of the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who died on November 24, 1991.

angles.name: Queen Legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, the world lost an irreplaceable talent, Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?
